verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਕੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj dhe ghar cha(n)dhramaa vair virodh uThaavai kete|

en.bdb: When moon reaches the house of sun then (according to astrology) many enmities and oppositions erupt.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਆਵੈ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਘਰਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਹੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: sooraj aavai cha(n)dhr ghar vair visaar samaalai hete|

en.bdb: And if sun enters the house of moon, the enmity is forgotten and love emerges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: jotee jot samai kai pooran param jot chit chete|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh, having established his identity with the supreme light, always cherishes that flame in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਭੇਦ ਗੁਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਮਜਲਸ ਭੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: lok bhedh gun giaan mil piram piaalaa majalas bhete|

en.bdb: Understanding the mystery of the ways of the world, cultivating values and the knowledge of the Shastras, he quaffs the cup of love in the assembly (the holy congregation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee chhia dharasanaa ik sooraj gur giaan samete|

en.bdb: As the six seasons are caused by one sun, similarly all the six philosophies are the result of the consolidated knowledge of the one Guru (the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਜਹਬ ਵਰਨ ਸਪਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁ ਖੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: majahab varan saparas kar asaT dhaat ik dhaatu su khete|

en.bdb: As eight metals mix to make one alloy, similarly meeting the Guru, all the vamas and sects turn out to be the followers of the way of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਘਰ ਥਾਪੇ ਨਵੈਂ ਅੰਗ ਦਸਮਾਂ ਸੁੰਨ ਲੰਘਾਇ ਅਗੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: nau ghar thaape navai(n) a(n)g dhasamaa(n) su(n)n la(n)ghai agete|

en.bdb: Nine limbs form nine separate houses, but only the tenth gate of tranquillity, leads further to liberation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਅਨਾਹਦੋ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਨੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: neel aneel anaahadho nijhar dhaar apaar sanete|

en.bdb: Understanding the void (Sany), Jiv becomes infinite like the numbers of nil and anti and enjoys impossible water fall of His love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਅਲੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਨ ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh alekh lekh sa(n)kh asa(n)kh na satijug trete|

en.bdb: Then this jiv goes beyond the counts of twenty, twenty-one, millions or crores, innumerables, sad yugs, tretas yugs i.e. Jiv gets liberated from the time-cycle.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਦੇਵ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ta(n)bol ras dhev kare(n)dhaa pasoo parete|

en.bdb: As the four ingredients in a betel become beautiful and homogenous, similarly this benevolent Guru, transforms animals and ghosts into gods.
How can this land of saintliness be procured by money and wealth.
